tasks.label: Start MinIO Container
tasks.command: docker rm -f soba-minio || true && docker run -d --name soba-minio -p 9000:9000 -p 9001:9001 -e MINIO_ROOT_USER=minioadmin -e MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD=minioadminpassword minio/minio server /data --console-address ':9001' && echo 'Waiting for MinIO to initialize...' && sleep 3 && docker exec soba-minio mc alias set myminio http://127.0.0.1:9000 minioadmin minioadminpassword && docker exec soba-minio mc mb --ignore-existing myminio/soba-bucket

tasks.label: Start Valkey Container
tasks.command: docker rm -f soba-valkey || true && docker run -d --name soba-valkey --restart unless-stopped -p 6379:6379 -v soba-valkey-data:/data valkey/valkey:8-alpine valkey-server --dir /data --maxmemory-policy volatile-lru --appendonly yes --appendfsync everysec && echo 'Valkey on localhost:6379 — supports cache + message bus + event streams (volatile-lru so TTL-less stream keys are protected; durable AOF in the soba-valkey-data volume). Enable the *-redis codes + PLUGIN_*_REDIS_URL in backend/.env.local (see .env.local.example). Fresh slate: docker volume rm soba-valkey-data'
